decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P 500 -0.3%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($489.29) sits just below the $500 buy threshold, and per past lessons we don't force a buy on neutral days — holding all 7 positions and waiting for a genuine risk-on setup.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with the NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, a quiet, directionless session without a strong catalyst either way. Trading volume and momentum signals across the screened universe remain mixed rather than broadly bullish or bearish. With no dominant sector theme driving flows, the market essentially took a pause after recent moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，NASDAQ下跌0.1%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，屬於方向不明的觀望盤。市場缺乏明顯的利多或利空消息帶動，成交量與動能指標呈現分歧，並未一面倒地偏多或偏空。在沒有主導性板塊題材的情況下，大盤在近期走勢後進入短暫的整理階段。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was just below our buy threshold and the market gave no strong risk-on signal, so the disciplined move is to hold that cash rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是保留在場邊、等待良機出手的現金。今日現金餘額剛好低於買入門檻，市場也沒有明顯的risk-on訊號，因此紀律性的做法是繼續持有現金，而不是勉強進場交易。
